sources.name: Fellowship of the Wheel trail conditions
sources.how_to_read: The FOTW page has no status text of its own: each network is an embedded Trailforks widget (TrailforksWidgetMap/TrailforksWidgetReports divs with data-rid). The widget iframes (trailforks.com/widgets/trailreports, region_status, trails_status) and trailforks.com/region pages return a Cloudflare 403 to curl and to WebFetch; the Trailforks API (trailforks.com/api/1/...) answers 401 without an app_id/app_secret, so a script needs an API key from Trailforks (or a headless browser, which may still be blocked). The mapping of network name to region id above was read from the page HTML.
sources.update_cadence: Not visible without Trailforks access; FOTW page itself is static text.
sources.current_status_snapshot: Page banner: 'Please use caution with wet areas and deep puddles. Ride THROUGH and not around!' Per-trail statuses not readable today (Trailforks blocked).
sources.seasonality: Year-round; most relevant in spring mud season and after heavy rain.

Titles prefixed 'Now Open:' mean the closure has been lifted; the post stays listed. greenmountainclub.org/alert/feed/ is a 404; the site-wide /feed/ RSS covers blog posts, not alerts.
sources.update_cadence: Latest alert posted 2026-10-28, modified 2026-10-29; roughly several alerts a month in season.
sources.current_status_snapshot: Burrows Trail (Huntington) closed Oct 28 for an emergency incident, now open. Elmore and Spruce Mtn fire towers closed for repairs through end of October. Taft Lodge (Mt. Mansfield) closed for repairs Sept 8 to end of October.

sources.name: Trail Finder trail status
sources.owner: Trail Finder (trailfinder.info); FPR and GMC say state-land closures are posted here
sources.how_to_read: Each trail page carries the sentence 'This trail system is currently OPEN/CLOSED' plus a Trail Alerts tab; parse that per trail slug (e.g. /trails/trail/abbey-pond). The list page has a closureStatus filter, but passing field[closureStatus.raw]=Closed as a query string returned the unfiltered list of 974 trails, so filtering appears to be client-side; no JSON API found. Pages load reCAPTCHA scripts, but plain curl with a browser UA got the HTML.
sources.update_cadence: Per trail; not dated on list page.
sources.current_status_snapshot: Example read today: Abbey Pond (Middlebury/Ripton) 'currently CLOSED'. No Burlington-area trail was individually checked.
sources.seasonality: Year-round; heavy use in mud season.

sources.name: VTrans lane/road closures (New England Compass C2C feed)
sources.owner: Vermont Agency of Transportation via New England Compass
covers: seasonal gap road closures (Lincoln Gap, Smugglers' Notch VT-108)
sources.how_to_read: Public XML (C2C schema, ~540 KB) linked from the Developer Portal (nec-por.ne-compass.com/DeveloperPortal), no key; the portal says use implies accepting its Terms and Data Sharing Principles. Each <laneClosure> has <desc>, <roadway>, start/end lat/lon (micro-degrees: divide by 1e6) and lastUpdatedTimestamp. Filter roadway VT-108 and descriptions mentioning 'Gap' or 'Winter Season'. feed_type is xml (not one of the listed enum values).
sources.update_cadence: Real-time ATMS data; 56 Vermont lane closures in today's file.
sources.current_status_snapshot: VT-108 Smugglers' Notch: 'now OPEN to all traffic' (opened 5/4/2026, entry last updated 2026-10-17). Lincoln Gap Rd (Lincoln–Warren): 'CLOSED for the 2026 Winter Season' (posted 2026-10-19).
sources.seasonality: Gap roads close for winter (typically late fall to spring).
